officialName: Request for Grant of Patent Under Section 26(1) & 52(2)
purpose: Request the grant of a patent to a person who succeeded in an opposition (s.25(3)) or a revocation petition (s.64) — in lieu of a revoked patent, or in respect of subject matter excluded by an amendment — supported by the order and a certified copy.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries numbered instructions (1-9); right column carries the declaration in five sub-parts (i)-(v). The applicant block (a)-(c) repeats per applicant.

sections.title: Applicant(s)
sections.description: Instruction 1: repeat columns (a)-(c) for more than one applicant.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: (a) Name
fields.helpText: Name in full, family/principal name first.

fields.label: (b) Address
fields.helpText: Complete address incl postal code and state and/or country.

sections.title: Declaration (i) — Prior Opposition / Petition
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'hereby declare: (i) that I/We made opposition under section 25(3) before the Controller or a petition under Section 64 of the Act before the Appellate Board or High Court of ...... and the details of the patent and the opposition for the petition are given below:'. Complete the High Court/forum and petition fields only if you proceeded by petition; the opposition-notice date only if you proceeded by opposition.

fields.text: hereby declare: (i) that I/We made opposition under section 25(3) before the Controller or a petition under Section 64 of the Act before the Appellate Board or High Court of

fields.label: Name of the High Court / forum
fields.helpText: Complete only if you proceeded by petition under Section 64.

validation.message: Enter the High Court or forum.

fields.text: and the details of the patent and the opposition for the petition are given below:

validation.message: Enter the grantee/patentee of the opposed patent.

fields.label: Opposition Notice dated
fields.helpText: Complete only if you proceeded by opposition under section 25(3).

fields.label: Petition No.
fields.helpText: Complete only if you proceeded by petition under Section 64.

fields.label: Petition dated
fields.helpText: Complete only if you proceeded by petition under Section 64.

sections.title: Declaration (ii) — Claim to Inventorship
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'that I/We have claimed to be the true and first inventor(s)/assignee(s)/legal representative(s) of ...... the true and first inventor of the invention for which the said patent was granted.'

Name of the true and first inventor

validation.message: Enter the true and first inventor.

fields.text: the true and first inventor of the invention for which the said patent was granted.

sections.title: Declaration (iii) — Order Outcome
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'that by an order in the said opposition or petition the patent was revoked / the complete specification of the patent was directed to be amended by exclusion of ...... claims thereof.'

fields.text: that by an order in the said opposition or petition

fields.label: the patent was revoked / the complete specification was directed to be amended by exclusion of claims

options.label: the complete specification of the patent was directed to be amended by exclusion of claims thereof

validation.message: Identify the claims excluded by the amendment.

fields.text: that the Controller or Appellate Board or Court ordered to grant to me a patent in lieu of the said patent / part of the invention excluded by the amendment.

that I/We submit a statement and certified copy of the order of the Controller or Appellate Board or Court in support of my application and request that a patent be granted to me in accordance with the order of the Appellate Board or Court.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 7: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/Our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

attachments.label: Statement and certified copy of the order of the Controller / Appellate Board / Court
attachments.note: Declaration (v): submitted in support of the request for grant.

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (Grantee/Patentee, inventor/assignee/legal representative, revoked/amended, patent/part of the invention).
Attachments required: a statement and a certified copy of the order of the Controller / Appellate Board / Court (declaration (v)).
Declarations (i)-(v) encode a post-opposition/post-revocation scenario; in (i), complete the High Court/petition fields for the petition route and the opposition-notice date for the opposition route.
